parameters.name: AuthnSignAlgo
parameters.description:
The supported signature algorithm. Valid values:

- rsa-sha256

- rsa-sha1 (default)

parameters.name: EncodedSAMLMetadataDocument
parameters.description:
The metadata file, which is Base64-encoded.

The file is provided by an IdP that supports Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0.

parameters.name: SAMLProviderName
parameters.description:
The IdP name.

It can be up to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, `periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)`. The name cannot start or end with `periods (.), hyphens (-), or underscores (_)`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims create-saml-provider --saml-provider-name test-provider --description This_is_a_provider. --encoded-saml-metadata-document PD94bWwgdmVy0000 --authn-sign-algo rsa-sha1 --region cn-hangzhou
